title: Network Bulletin: Cash Pickup Shortfall Re-issues After Out-of-Cash Refusals
content:
When a Cash Pickup payout location has refused a pickup on a transfer because it had no cash, the network adds days to the window of any later re-issue of a shortfall on that transfer.

**Rule.** Count the pickups on the transfer that were refused because the payout location had no cash. Refusals recorded at any time on the transfer are counted.

| Out-of-cash refusals recorded on the transfer | Days added to the re-issue window |
|---|---|
| two or more | 7 |
| exactly one | 3 |
| none | none |

Refusals for any other reason do not count. Those reasons are a name on the ID that does not match, an expired ID, no valid ID shown, and a wrong Pickup Number.

The days are whole calendar days and lengthen the re-issue window. They move its last day of collection later by the same number of days.

## Examples (hypothetical refusal histories)

- Two refusals because the location lacked cash, and one for an expired ID: two count, so 7 days.
- One refusal because the location lacked cash: 3 days.
- Three refusals, all for a name mismatch: none count, so no days.
- Four refusals because the location lacked cash: still 7 days. The top band is "two or more".
